description: Expected bytes derived by hand from the rule text at rc.5 (RC5-A); the reference engine does not yet produce them, so this vector is listed in tests/conformance/pending.json until RC5-B. Supersedes bnd-0005 and closes the one blocker for 1.0.0. bnd-0005 called followRedirects with no resolution map, so the AGSC-11-08 address guard could only be satisfied conditionally and a fail-open branch had to survive in the transport rules. Here every hop carries a resolution, so the guard is unconditional. Two cases. (1) hop-cap: four hops on a host resolving to a globally reachable address — three are followed, the fourth exceeds federation.redirect_limit and the fetch is refused with AGSC-E905 (AGSC-11-09). (2) refused-address-hop: the FIRST hop leaves for a host resolving to 127.0.0.1, a loopback address AGSC-11-08 refuses in both families — the fetch is refused with AGSC-E905 before any hop is followed, so followed is 0 and the cap is never reached. In both cases the declared peer URL is never replaced by the final URL.
